answer_2.quote: Five metrics commonly adopted in prior works are: ROUGE (R) , Truth Ratio (TR) , Probability (P) , Cosine Similarity (CS) , LLM-as-Judge (LLM) ... We evaluate unlearning with three primary metrics: Model utility (MU) ... and SEPS ... Specifically, MU is computed as the harmonic mean of the four components ...

answer_3.quote: We primarily employ LLM-as-Judge scores to quantify the MU, FE, and SEPS of unlearned models.
